# sequential-search

> Mathematical search abstractions and finite reasoning reference algorithms.
> Distribution: sequential-search-core. Import: sequential_search. Python 3.11+.

This index describes the current repository checkout. Development reasoning and
checkpoint APIs may differ from published releases; inspect the selected tag.
Links provide navigation, not a promise of indexing or automatic AI ingestion.

## Start here

- [Plain-language overview](docs/overview.md): who it is for, choices, inputs/outputs, FAQ and limits.
- [Обзор на русском](docs/overview.ru.md): назначение, выбор возможностей, входные данные, результаты и ограничения.
- [README](README.md): status, architectural history and installation.
- [Coding guidance](AGENTS.md): commands and contribution boundaries.

## Implemented development contracts

- [Finite reasoning](docs/ADR-008-reasoning-search.md): forward/backward/bidirectional search, proofs and missing premises.
- [Reasoning source](src/sequential_search/reasoning.py): pure finite implication algorithms.
- [Reasoning tests](tests/test_reasoning.py): checked examples, failure modes and independent truth-table oracle.
- [Checkpoint envelope](docs/ADR-007-checkpoint-envelope.md): topology, evidence, lifecycle and reservations.
- [Checkpoint source](src/sequential_search/io/checkpoint.py): explicit codecs and validation.
- [Statistical procedure adapter](src/sequential_search/stats/procedure.py): integration with sequential-analysis.
- [SPRT anchor tests](tests/test_degenerate_anchor.py): comparison with standalone inference.

## Design history and unresolved work

- [Kernel boundaries](docs/ADR-003-kernel-scope.md): mathematical responsibilities; includes historical proposals.
- [Withdrawal and resume](docs/ADR-006-resumable-search-and-known-partner.md): requirements and open alpha-accounting questions.

A verified implication proof is not an automatic subject-domain proof; a
serialized budget is not a global statistical guarantee. Applications and
production runtimes belong to the sequentialist engineering/application layers.
